editorial.blurb: A hidden gem ghost kitchen turning out some of Chicago's freshest, most creative sushi with surprising touches of genuine care.
editorial.insiderTip: Order for delivery to avoid the tricky pickup location in the ghost kitchen lobby—the experience is worth it, and they'll likely include thoughtful handwritten notes and complimentary pieces.
